data.design: White winter setting later stained purple and green by defensive poison. Proposed: Snowy courtyards, shared kitchens, training areas, sheltered paths and gardens. These are bible proposals, not a finished map.

description:
A white mountain settlement organized around a dojo community inspired by Koga and his absent mother. Respectful apprentices invite practice. Pseudo-Koga later defends it with poison: the protection works against a threat but turns the town purple with toxins and green with sludge.

After the poisoning, a proposed repair of one path or shared room would show survival without erasing the damage.

Koga is known through practical help, his sister’s testimony and respectful training. Warmth must exist before his absence.

Proposed daily work: apprentices clear snow from covered passages before inviting practice; the kitchen measures food for both residents and arriving travelers. Rope, dry gloves and repaired walking staffs hang where anybody leaving can check them. Koga’s sister can keep this work going while others wait for the prodigy to solve their danger. A blocked delivery first changes portions and repair work, before it changes anyone’s ideals.

Proposed escalation: the imitation’s first perimeter succeeds at turning danger away, so residents agree to a second one. People then have to choose between a shorter protected walk beside contaminated snow and a longer route carrying clean supplies by hand. When dissent is treated as a breach in protection, shared maintenance becomes coerced obedience. After the fight, one cleared covered passage can reopen the kitchen to those who sheltered separately; purple snow remains outside. Recovery is work the community undertakes, not an automatic palette reset.

Proposed sound: brooms scrape sheltered stone before practice; a bowl is set down beyond the kitchen screen. After poisoning, retain those small sounds around the reopened room, with the former group practice absent. Survivors are doing work, not waiting silently for the music to announce hope.

data.description: Proposed watershed: runoff from the poisoned mountain town reaches the refuge along recognizable watercourses. This supports investigation without fixing the final overworld map.

sections: §§3.5, 5.5, 6.4 and 8.2: protection, costs, communal practice and sister’s agency. Specific routines and contested path are proposed.

data.description: Proposed reciprocal exchange: apprentices help escort difficult upland loads and repair rope crossings; the river community supplies food and transport. Koga’s help occurs within an existing relationship rather than creating it alone.

name: Winter dojo settlement
